faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before working with us
faq.q1: How long does a website take to build?
faq.a1: Typically 2-6 weeks depending on complexity. A simple business site takes 2 weeks, while a full e-commerce platform can take 4-6 weeks.
faq.q2: Which areas of Saudi Arabia do you serve?
faq.a2: Services are available for businesses in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Makkah, Madinah, and across Saudi Arabia. This describes service coverage, not physical office locations.
faq.a3: We're framework-agnostic but specialize in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, React Native, Flutter, and PostgreSQL.
faq.a4: Yes. Maintenance scope, service levels, and response windows are agreed for each project before work begins.
faq.q5: Can you work within our existing codebase?
faq.a5: Absolutely — we do code audits, upgrades, and can seamlessly integrate with your existing team and codebase.
faq.a6: Yes — all client work is fully confidential. We're happy to sign NDAs before any project discussion.
faq.a7: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery. For large projects, we break payments into milestones tied to deliverables.
faq.q8: Do you have Arabic-speaking team members?
faq.a8: We design and build complete Arabic RTL and English LTR experiences, including content structure, forms, metadata, and interface behavior.
